instruction: I want my desktop background to rotate through my favorite photos. Can you set up a wallpaper slideshow for me?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because wallpaper slideshow configuration involves setting up automatic rotation of desktop backgrounds, which requires verifying timer-based image changes. The OSWorld evaluation framework cannot reliably verify time-based dynamic behavior or confirm that slideshow settings are correctly configured to rotate images at specified intervals.

llm_judge_reasons: The 'infeasible' evaluator is correctly applied to this task
The metadata explanation accurately identifies the verification challenge: wallpaper slideshow requires verifying time-based dynamic behavior (automatic image rotation)

While configuration state (slideshow enabled, folder selected, interval set) could theoretically be checked via GNOME settings/dconf, verifying actual rotation behavior is beyond framework capabilities
The decision to mark this as infeasible is semantically correct - the task cannot be reliably verified within OSWorld's evaluation constraints
